info.name: Spotify - Black Edition | Amber Gold
info.description:
Seven Colors. One Unified Experience.

Each edition preserves the same refined black-and-glowing interface while introducing a different neon identity. From the classic hacker aesthetic of Matrix Green to the electric intensity of Blue, Purple, Cyan, Pink, Amber, and Red, every version delivers a cohesive, immersive visual environment.

Spotify —  Black Edition transforms the familiar Spotify Web Player into a streamlined, futuristic music dashboard where every detail—from the smallest control icon to the full-screen lyrics experience—belongs to one coordinated visual theme.

An independently developed CSS customization for the Spotify Web Player. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Spotify.
